name: disable_script_object_damage

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_DisableScriptObjectDamage does not access or change the Script value stack

notes: ScriptCommand_DisableScriptObjectDamage queues operation types 0x24 and 0x2B for the object ID stored at Script offset 0. Both types map to embedded DAMAGE_OFF entries; their dispatchers set damage-disable flags 0x01000080 and 0x40, and type 0x24 also clears the state field at +0x0C. The JP corpus contains 141 calls; 123 immediately follow command 55 disable_selected_object_control, while 86 are immediately followed by command 26 disable_selected_object_collision.
